protocol.cost_units: relative experimental units; draw=0 denotes an already collected sample
protocol.selection: minimum validation cost subject to 99% of full-versus-base validation C-index improvement; if infeasible, maximum validation C-index with explicit failure flag
protocol.external_selection: none; transfer primary-validation operating points and intersect ordered/static/panel actions with four available tests
protocol.panel_rule: direct predicted base-to-subset gain for all 57 multi-test subsets; observed inputs limited to base state
protocol.external_full_panel: four compatible laboratory tests, not the six-test primary full panel
protocol.inference: paired event-stratified participant bootstrap conditional on fitted models, selected policies and fixed estimated censoring weights
protocol.censoring_assumption: marginal Kaplan-Meier IPCW assumes independent censoring; weights are fitted on fold training data for OOF targets, primary training data for internal evaluation, and NAGALA for external evaluation only
protocol.missing_result_rule: requested tests are charged even when retrospective results are missing; imputation uses only the corresponding training partition
protocol.study_status: exploratory extension; internal test and NAGALA were previously examined in v1; no claim of a new untouched confirmatory cohort

bootstrap.method: event-stratified paired percentile bootstrap, conditional on fitted policies and censoring weights
